items.headline: Belgorod came under attack by Ukrainian UAVs
items.excerpt: 🇺🇦🇷🇺⚡️ — Belgorod came under attack by Ukrainian UAVs. Authorities report one person killed and ten others injured, including an ambulance worker. The enemy also attacked Rostov Oblast, the Republic of Adygea, Stavropol Krai, and Krasnodar Krai, with UAV alerts and warnings issued in nearly every district. Air raid alerts were also sounded in other regions of the country.
